results.description: High-density surface electromyography (HDsEMG) recordings from six healthy male subjects performing isometric contractions of the tibialis anterior muscle at 30% and 50% maximum voluntary contraction. results.title: [TEST COPY] Electrophysiological markers of surprise-induced failures of visual and auditory awareness
results.description: This dataset contains electrophysiological recordings from 33 participants performing visual and auditory surprise tasks. The study investigates electrophysiological markers associated with surprise-induced failures of awareness across sensory modalities. EEG data were collected during counterbalanced presentation of visual and auditory oddball-like tasks, with detailed event annotations and preprocessing information provided for reproducibility.

results.title: [TEST COPY] BNCI 2014-004 Motor Imagery dataset
results.description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 9 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing two-class motor imagery (left vs. right hand), known as BCI Competition IV Dataset 2b (Graz data set B). Each participant completed five sessions: two screening sessions without feedback and three sessions with smiley feedback. Three bipolar EEG channels (C3, Cz, C4) and three EOG channels were recorded at 250 Hz.
